content:
Thanks for creating this registry :) I was able to register two entries, and wanted to share both:

PALOMAR-2026-08-19-000006 — a chirality package for the Padovan substitution (a ↦ b, b ↦ c, c ↦ ab): every a in a positive iterate is followed by b, ca occurs as a factor while ac never does from any seed, and no factor of length ≥ 4 of any iterate, from any seed, is a palindrome. Gähler's recent computational work (arXiv:2602.18501) establishes the corresponding tiling-space asymmetry; these are kernel-checked counterparts at the factor level.

PALOMAR-2026-08-19-000007 — the exact CHSH constants: Tsirelson's bound ‖T‖ ≤ 2√2 in norm form for any nontrivial unital real C*-normed algebra, ‖T‖ = 2 exactly when either party commutes, any violation forcing noncommutativity in both parties, and 2√2 as the greatest CHSH operator norm over M₄(ℝ), attained. En route, Landau's identity T² = 4 + [A₀,A₁][B₁,B₀], and a falsification: the saturating tuple's T² is not c·1 for any scalar (the textbook shortcut is false). This builds on Mathlib's Algebra.Star.CHSH and touches its "future work" note.
